$comment: Regression-eval expectations for the recorded real-PR fixtures (scripts/eval.ts). claimVerdict: every claim whose text contains textIncludes (case-insensitive) must have the verdict; required=true means the claim must exist. noClaimVerdict: no matching claim may have that verdict (empty textIncludes = all claims). contradictedMustCiteKind: every CONTRADICTED claim of the category must cite a check run classified as that kind. These encode the P1 precision review's invariants: pre-fix problem prose must not be contradicted, tests-pass claims are not refuted by non-test CI failures, and no test-kind evidence means UNVERIFIED.

expectations.$comment: The typo-fix outcome claim (the section title correction) must be VERIFIED against the diff hunk.
The pre-fix problem statement ('the SDK stays in its recording/paused phase...') must never be judged CONTRADICTED again.
'All 41 SDK tests pass' must be UNVERIFIED: the only test-kind checks were skipped in CI; the failing checks (Format (Biome), Vercel) are lint/deploy, not tests.
A tests_pass contradiction is legitimate only if it cites a test-kind check.
Nothing in this PR's claims can be contradicted: local test-run claims are UNVERIFIED, not CONTRADICTED.

'ctest -LE flaky: 1287/1287 pass' is a local-machine claim (CI has no matching executed test-kind check) -> UNVERIFIED. Not required: extraction picks up to 12 claims and is not deterministic on Bedrock even at temperature 0.
